readme.text:
English | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)

**Give one goal to a team of leading harnesses.** Research, collaborate, share tools,
and keep improving the same deliverable against strong real-world references.
Make useful improvements available to later work, not just one conversation.

readme.section: Legion · Leading harnesses. Shared evolution. World-class ambition.
readme.text:
Open to different harnesses rather than tied to one. Shared evolution and world-class
outcomes are the ambition; actual members and results remain evidence-backed,
not a claim that every harness is ready or every result leads the industry.

Start in DSH: choose companions, describe what you want, and follow the task and its results in the original conversation. Connect your independent Legion core when you want to delegate work to its members.

readme.section: One goal. Shared tools. Improvements that reach the team.
readme.text:
| What matters | What the entry provides |
|---|---|
| **Continue one piece of work together** | Choose candidates and collaboration preferences, then use the original task and conversation to continue revisions instead of starting over. |
| **Put useful tools to work** | Discover visible capabilities, inspect real interfaces, and use authorized tool and message paths to contribute to the original task. |
| **Make improvements reusable** | In the historical 0.5.1 case, DSH independently reproduced and fixed Codex review findings; the maintainer imported the changes and reran the regression tests. Automatic propagation to later tasks remains unproven. |
| **Compare with strong real-world work** | Research relevant high-quality references, compare actual outcomes and revise the same deliverable. Benchmarking is a process, not an unsupported victory claim. |

readme.section: One goal. Shared tools. Improvements that reach the team.
readme.text: **DSH is an entry point; the co-evolving team is the product.** It is not a menu for choosing one assistant or a pile of independent answers. [The product idea](docs/PRODUCT.md#one-team) · [Mechanisms and boundaries](docs/ECOSYSTEM.md#co-evolving-team)

readme.section: Get started
readme.text:
1. Check the [**0.6.0 installation target and channel receipts**](docs/MARKET.md#v060), use the version actually offered by the verified Release or Discover index, then explicitly enable Legion. Git distribution does not require publishing this connector to npm.
2. Open **Legion**, choose a **Working session**, then follow **Companions → Collaboration → Grow together**. The improvement plan is enabled by default, while outcomes still require verification; submitting saves the preferences and schedules the first round and weekly follow-ups through native DSH, with pause and original-conversation entry points. [Workflow and boundaries](docs/TEAM.md)
3. For delegated work, verify the [matching 0.6.0 core source and actual release package](docs/RELEASE-PAIR.md#v060), then use the [existing setup procedure](docs/CORE.md#安装自己的实例): a fresh Python 3.12 environment, **`init` → `serve` → `dsh-config` → Save connection**. Configure your own model before submitting work; the connector does not bundle or start the core.

readme.section: Get started
readme.text:
**Installation template, not a verified live 0.6.0 target.** Replace the placeholder with the tag or full commit confirmed by the actual Release and its package checksums. If no matching target is verifiable, leave installation pending; do not substitute `main` or relabel an older version. Replace the example `web` profile as needed and retain `-w`:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web -w add 'github:seanliii/dsh-plugin-legion#<verified-tag-or-full-commit>'
```

readme.section: Get started
readme.text:
Users supply their own models and accounts; no shared credentials are included. The separately installed [historical public core v0.1.0](https://github.com/seanliii/meyo-legion-core/releases/tag/v0.1.0) retains its original identity and receipts, not those of the 0.5.2 pair. First-party source is MIT and third-party licenses are retained. Local verification does not establish a Git push, npm publication or marketplace approval.

Give DSH a real goal, for example:

readme.section: Get started
readme.text:
```text
For this goal, give me a working result I can keep using and modifying.
Collaborate with configured members when useful, and fix the same deliverable
when you find a problem—not several unrelated answers.
```

Use **Discover** directly: current DSH tools, Skills and public GitHub search need no Legion core. Try this in an ordinary DSH conversation:

readme.section: Get started

Find an existing plugin for the capability I need. Show its sources and limitations before installing anything.

[0.5.0 post-release receipts on GitHub main](https://github.com/seanliii/dsh-plugin-legion/blob/main/docs/PLAN.md#v050) · [Limits, data and license](#limits-data-and-license)

<details>
<summary>Tool interfaces and their exact boundaries</summary>

readme.section: Get started
readme.text:
| Need | Entry point | Boundary |
|---|---|---|
| Find an existing capability | `legion_discover` | Current Agent-visible tools, user-configured native markets, or public GitHub; not a machine-wide inventory. |
| Read a project's interfaces and license | `legion_source` | Pinned source, file hashes and bounded previews; incomplete reads stay explicit. |
| Package code already adapted by an author | `legion_bundle` | Writes workspace files and metadata; does not install or execute them. |
| Install or switch capabilities | Official `plugin_manager` | Native installation, approvals, bundle selection and individual plugin switches. |
| See what your Legion service really has | `legion_runtime` | Current member, capability or catalog observations; registration is not installation, configuration or verified execution. |
| Delegate work and continue revisions | `legion_submit` | Real delegation; `previous_task_ref` reconnects to the original Legion conversation. |
| Use a local tool for a Legion task | `legion_call`, then a separate `legion_message` | Execution and delivery are two decisions; a mailbox receipt is not model consumption. |
| Follow remote work | `legion_status` | Task stat

readme.section: Get started
readme.text: You can also ask DSH to inspect a public repository, adapt its real interfaces, and package independently useful capabilities. **This is not an automatic converter for arbitrary applications.** The on-demand `legion-ecosystem` skill supplies the available tools and development references.

readme.section: Get started
readme.text:
The core retains world-reference research, intent context, native collaboration, knowledge reuse, failure feedback, continued revision and formal delivery through existing modules. See the [capability map](docs/CORE.md). Retaining a mechanism does not prove every member is installed or that a team generally outperforms the strongest individual harness.

</details>

readme.section: Install a reviewed local copy
readme.text: Requirements: **Node.js >=24.9.0** and official npm DSH **`0.2.1-rc.2`**. The Agent needs the relevant native tools: `write` for generated files, `plugin_manager` for installation, and optionally `plugin_market` for configured indexes. Slash commands additionally need the Host's `commands` service.

readme.section: Install a reviewed local copy
readme.text:
The sidebar needs DSH's browser UI, session and command services. Editable settings, Skills, markets and bundle management use the corresponding native services when available; the workbench does not bypass missing services or permissions.

If you already have a reviewed local copy, use the official `plugin_manager`. Replace the placeholder below with its **absolute bundle directory**, preserving any spaces:

readme.section: Install a reviewed local copy
readme.text:
```json
{
  "action": "install_bundle",
  "target": "file:<absolute bundle directory>",
  "enabled": false

This is a parameter template, not a published package address. For public pinned-Git installation and community catalog submission, see [publication routes](docs/MARKET.md).

readme.section: Install a reviewed local copy
readme.text:
- Prefer `file:` for package installation with declared dependencies. A bare directory can become a development `link:` whose target dependencies are not installed recursively. A local directory is mutable, not a content hash.
- With `enabled:false`, new bundles are not automatically selected for activation; updates preserve existing switches. If you do not want updated code to run, disable that bundle before updating. **Disabled does not mean dependency build scripts cannot run**: inspect native warnings and any `pendingBuilds`; build permission is separate.
- After reviewing the installation result, manage the bundle with `set_bundle`. Read **actual `entryId` values from `list_plugins`** before using `set_plugin`; declared `rowId`/module names are not runtime IDs. A disabled bundle may have no runtime entries.
- Bundle selection may load all default-enabled rows. Installation, selection, activation and actual calls are different facts. Preserve `application`, `changed`, warnings and restart requirements; do not assume a failed load rolled back selection.

readme.section: Install a reviewed local copy
readme.text: Host plugins run **outside the agent sandbox**. Review code and dependencies before trusting them; see [Security](docs/SECURITY.md).

readme.section: Open the native workbench
readme.text: After installing and enabling the connector in **DSH Plugins**, open **Legion** in DSH's sidebar. This is a native DSH page, not another website or service. Choose the **Working session** at the top right; a single existing session is selected automatically. If none exist, create a DSH conversation, then click **Refresh sessions**. No core yet? Go straight to **Discover**; an unconnected members page does not block discovery.

readme.section: Open the native workbench
readme.text:
| Page | What to do | What it means |
|---|---|---|
| **My Legion (0.5.0)** | **Companions → Collaboration → Grow together → Form team and start automatically**. Inspect schedules, open results, run again or pause. | Saves native `candidateHarnesses` and `teamProfile`, schedules the first round and defaults to weekly follow-ups. Selection is not installation; scheduling and delivery do not prove completed improvement. |
| **Discover** | Search **Session tools / Skills**, **GitHub**, or **DSH plugin market**. | Tools are those visible to the selected session's Agent; Skills are guidance. Only configured market indexes are searched. No core is required, and discovery executes no tools. |
| **Add capabilities** | Inspect and explicitly install an existing DSH bundle, or edit a goal and **Delegate integration**. | Native package management and model-led adaptation are different operations; reading a repository does neither automatically. |
| **Team tasks** | **Refresh tasks**, then **Read live progress**; inspect export records and use **Download file** where available. | The list is this session and identity's local recovery index, not a live feed. Runtime, artifacts, refusal reasons

readme.section: Open the native workbench
readme.text: Switching the working session changes tool visibility and task context, **not** the scope of settings: bundle switches and connector configuration affect the same DSH profile. Only members the service marks as selectable can be checked. Saving needs writable native configuration; on a revision conflict, reload it before editing again.

readme.section: Install a bundle, or delegate an adaptation
readme.text:
- **Already a DSH bundle:** on **Add capabilities**, enter a package name, Git source or local bundle → **Inspect source** → review it → **Install / update**. New bundles are not automatically selected for activation; updates preserve existing switches, so enabled code may keep running. **To prevent updated code from running, disable the bundle below before installing the update.** These buttons keep DSH's official `pluginManager` and `enabled:false`, not a second installer or a forced-disable operation. Inspection accepts a source format/metadata, not its safety. Handle `pendingBuilds` in **DSH Plugins**; disabled bundles can still have dependency build steps.
- **Then choose what to enable:** under **Installed DSH capability bundles**, use **Enable bundle / Disable bundle** and expand **Individual plugins and loading state** for **Enable plugin / Disable plugin**. Respect read-only or restart-required results. This workbench cannot disable its own Legion connector; use DSH Plugins for that. Search session tools again, then actually use the capability in DSH; installation, visibility and execution are separate checks.
- **Still a source project:** a GitHub result's **Inspect & del

readme.section: Install a bundle, or delegate an adaptation
readme.text: If an install reply is uncertain, keep its request ID and use **Recover install result**, not another installation. **Request cancellation** is a request, not confirmation of cancellation. An uncertain delegation offers **Retry with the original key** while that operation is retained; do not change keys to repeat an unknown side effect.

readme.section: Install a bundle, or delegate an adaptation
readme.text: The task page does not auto-poll or execute incoming messages. It can page through artifact records and events, and **Download file** reuses the existing **`/legion download`** command in the selected original conversation. The file is saved on the **DSH Host**, not automatically in the browser's Downloads folder; the receipt shows its path, byte count and hash check. Same-name/history records remain distinct, and clipped details or refusal reasons stay marked incomplete. Continuation, feedback and cancellation still use **`/legion` in the original conversation**, not new task-page actions. [Projection and download limits](docs/PROTOCOL.md#workbench-projection) · [Detailed workflows](docs/ECOSYSTEM.md#native-workbench).

readme.section: Connect your independently installed Legion core
readme.text: For 0.6.0, first check the [paired core identity and channel receipts](docs/RELEASE-PAIR.md#v060). The v0.1.0 download link below is retained as a historical installation example, not the new pair's package.

readme.section: Connect your independently installed Legion core
readme.text:
Download the [public v0.1.0 archive and SHA-256](docs/CORE.md#public-core-install), then follow [Core installation](docs/CORE.md#安装自己的实例): a fresh **Python 3.12** environment → `init` → `serve` → `dsh-config` → **Save connection**. Model configuration is needed before real delegation, not to obtain the source. Existing authorized instances can continue to use their own connection settings.

Keep `serve` running. On the same machine, open another terminal in the core source directory and run:

readme.section: Connect your independently installed Legion core
readme.text:
```sh
.venv/bin/python -I meyo.py dsh-config --state-dir "/absolute/path/to/your/private-instance"
```

Use its **`config` object** to fill **Connection → Core URL / private token file path → Save connection**, or the equivalent native plugin settings. The output contains a service address and credential-file path, never the credential:

```json
{
  "baseUrl": "http://127.0.0.1:8015",
  "tokenFile": "/absolute/path/to/your/private-instance/login-token.txt"
}

readme.section: Connect your independently installed Legion core
readme.text: `tokenFile` is operator configuration, not a model-chosen path. It must be an owner-only regular file on the DSH Host (use mode `0600`), containing one token and no more than 4096 bytes. The page neither reads nor displays its contents. A configured but invalid file fails explicitly; there is no environment fallback.

readme.section: Connect your independently installed Legion core
readme.text: **Rotation is detected, not silently hot-swapped.** Each credential read rereads the file and checks for an identity change. Once a connector has bound an identity, a changed token stops that old connector and requires a **plugin reload** before using the new identity. Changing the service address or actual token selects a separate recovery index: old task references are not inherited, migrated or deleted.

readme.section: Connect your independently installed Legion core
readme.text: Saving configuration or reloading ends local pending requests; **it does not cancel remote tasks**. Rotating the file also does not cancel them or prove that the core accepts the new token. The page's **Reload configuration** button only rereads settings; use native plugin management to reload the connector. After saving/reloading, refresh members to check connectivity. Configuration accepted/read back is not model verification; submit a real task separately.

readme.section: Existing remote services: environment configuration remains supported
readme.text:
Configure these privately in the DSH Host environment. The JSON Environment editor needs **JSON string values, including quotes**; ordinary process environment variables use plain strings.

| Variable | Example JSON value |
|---|---|
| `LEGION_BASE_URL` | `"https://legion.example.invalid"` |
| `LEGION_PERSONAL_TOKEN` | `"<your-personal-token>"` |

readme.section: Existing remote services: environment configuration remains supported
readme.text: Keep the token **value** out of chat, commands, plugin configuration and Git. `tokenFile` accepts only a local absolute path and takes precedence over `tokenEnv` without fallback. Remote URLs require HTTPS; HTTP is allowed only on loopback. Installing this connector does not start a service. Optional candidates, project bindings and private state settings are in [Protocol](docs/PROTOCOL.md#7-configuration).

readme.section: Existing remote services: environment configuration remains supported
readme.text:
```text
/legion help
/legion runtime members
/legion runtime capabilities
/legion start page-1 Create a small HTML page with status text and a button.

Use references and artifact IDs returned by the tools, not the placeholders. `list`, `continue`, `message`, `resume` and `cancel` are also available. `legion_submit.tool_names` can share selected visible tool schemas; it grants no remote execution access.

readme.section: Share a local result in two steps
readme.text:
1. Use `legion_call` with the original task reference, recipient, stable operation key and selected native tool. Its first receipt is **pending**, not outer-call success. The bridge sends no HTTP or messages; the selected tool may have its own network behavior.
2. **Wait for the enclosing Host call to finish.** DSH then decides whether to use `legion_message`, with its own stable key, to share only the final content actually visible and appropriate to send. Do not combine execution and a success message inside the same `run_code` or another unfinished parent call.

readme.section: Share a local result in two steps
readme.text: The official result observer records ancestor **status metadata only**. Same-key, same-input recovery never reruns the tool or replays old result bodies, including after the target capability is disabled, provided this connector and the original session/state remain available. Unknown execution is not permission to change keys and repeat a side effect.

readme.section: Share a local result in two steps
readme.text: Message acknowledgement is separate from execution and **does not prove remote-model consumption or wake a finished task**. The bridge's text projection omits binary media; local DSH image forwarding is not full-media transfer to Legion. See the [two-step protocol](docs/PROTOCOL.md#6-two-step-collaboration).

readme.section: How DSH and Legion work together
readme.text: Express what you want once. DSH can discover existing capabilities, read actual source, adapt useful interfaces into native plugins, and delegate work to your Legion core for research, collaboration, revisions and file delivery. **The aim is one useful entry point into an ecosystem, not a larger control panel.**

readme.section: How DSH and Legion work together
readme.text:
```text
DSH: conversation, native tools, permissions and UI
  ↕ Legion plugin: discovery, source, packaging, tasks and files
Independent Legion core: research, orchestration, recovery and delivery
  ↕ Existing member/capability interfaces, installed and authorized as needed

The connector provides a five-page workbench in DSH's native sidebar. The actual Legion core is installed separately; native harnesses, media models and devices are added as needed.

readme.section: How DSH and Legion work together
readme.text: **No Legion core or token is needed to search current DSH tools, Skills or public GitHub.** Source reading, packaging and available native bundle-management services also work independently of the core. Skills provide guidance, not new executable tools. Collaboration requires a compatible service and a personal identity you are authorized to use. DSH keeps its own loop; Legion owns delegated work, and this connector does not add another commander.

readme.section: How DSH and Legion work together
readme.text: **[Core capabilities and installation](docs/CORE.md)** · [Ecosystem and principles](docs/ECOSYSTEM.md) · [Versioned evidence](docs/PLAN.md) · [Protocol](docs/PROTOCOL.md) · [Security](docs/SECURITY.md)

readme.section: Limits, data and license
readme.text: Repository text, catalog descriptions and task messages are untrusted material, not instructions or permission grants. Source hashes identify bytes; packaging is not runtime verification; download integrity is not file safety. Redaction is bounded, not a universal secret detector.

readme.section: Limits, data and license
readme.text: Keep recovery state private. New v2 native-call records retain metadata, not result bodies; old records and both systems' sessions may still contain content. Uninstalling does not delete user files or cancel remote work.

readme.section: Limits, data and license
readme.text: [MIT](LICENSE) covers this connector; the owner has separately confirmed MIT publication of the first-party core, selected auto-tools, packager and documentation. The [public core format and retained third-party licenses](docs/CORE.md#public-core-next-steps) keep `rights_verified=false` and `member_execution_verified=false`, without a `public_license_granted` field. Old `private-local-only` packages and their metadata are unchanged. Publication and source verification are not runtime or all-member acceptance.

readme.section: Limits, data and license
readme.text: The core is installed separately, not bundled here. The Marked acceptance bundle is also a separate local artifact. User or instance data, credentials, private evidence and logs, unrelated company business code, company monorepos or their private history, complete third-party upstream repositories and model weights are not shipped here. Neither the capability map nor one successful task proves all members are installed, work unattended or generally outperform the strongest individual harness. This is independent community code, not an official DeepSeek product.

readme.section: Legion · 集结顶尖 Harness，共同进化，对标世界级成果
readme.text: [English](README.md) | 简体中文 **你给一个目标，让一支顶尖 Harness 战队为你做成。** 自主研究、分工协作、互用工具； 以同类顶级作品为参照，反复对比、验证和改进，把同一个作品做完整，让有效改进为后续工作所用。 不绑定一家，向各路优秀 Harness 开放接入。“共同进化、对标世界级”是产品追求； 具体成员与成果以真实运行证据为准，不宣称全部成员已就绪或每次都达到世界第一。 从 DSH 开始：选战友、给目标，在原会话跟进任务和成果；需要委托成员工作时，连接你独立安装的军团核心。 **[0.6.0 安装与同源说明](docs/MARKET.md#v060) · [打开 DSH 工作台](#安装后从侧栏打开工作台) · [产品定位与已验证范围](docs/PRODUCT.md)**

readme.section: Legion · 集结顶尖 Harness，共同进化，对标世界级成果
readme.text:
**0.6.0：一支战队，一个维护源。** 核心与连接器在公开军团主库一起修改、一起验证； 原来的 DSH 安装地址保留，连接器由主库单向导出。停止原因、已产出结果和实际交付分别保留， 不再把“必须停下”误当成“已经做出的东西必须丢掉”。 [主库与维护方式](https://github.com/seanliii/meyo-legion-core/blob/main/docs/development.md) · [固定源码、包和验收范围](docs/RELEASE-PAIR.md#v060)。新版本的分数、安装与公开回执独立记录， 不继承下方旧版的通过数量，也不把同源打包当作无人自治或普遍领先。
此前 0.5.2 的本地验收记录（不是 0.6.0 的证明） **0.5.2：谁实际干活，现场与成果就跟着谁。** 把实际成员归属、预算与失败事实、正式成果交付接回原任务。目标仍是让顶尖 Harness 协作、互用能力、共同进化，不是在它们上方新加一个质量裁判。

readme.section: Legion · 集结顶尖 Harness，共同进化，对标世界级成果
readme.text:
本地原生安装已核 **34/34 文件**并启用 0.5.2，原 **6 个任务、身份与配置**保留，**1263 字节旧成果仍可下载**。[配套源码、回归数量与本地验收范围](docs/RELEASE-PAIR.md#v052)单独记录，不代替公开渠道回执。

完整固定样本 **52 × 13 = 676** 仍在跑，这里不填新分数或提分幅度。Superagent 仅实跑了 **3 个原生只读管理动作**，真实接单账号未接；Trinity 仅为待测候选。不能由这些验收宣称所有能力就绪、无人自治或世界第一。

</details>

[观看 0.5.1 历史改前／改后操作对比](https://github.com/seanliii/dsh-plugin-legion/releases/download/v0.5.1/dsh-v051-comparison.mp4) · 原速重放，章节之间有剪辑，无现场人声；不是模型工作耗时，也不是 0.5.2 新证据。

readme.section: Legion · 集结顶尖 Harness，共同进化，对标世界级成果
readme.text: **历史演示，仍属技术预览。** 0.5.0 验证了单 DSH 作者交付；0.5.1 已跑通 DSH 委托核心 Codex 独立评审、再由 DSH 独立复现并采纳反馈的限定双 Harness 协作。这轮有人介入，不是无人自治的战队进化。 **0.5.1 历史版本：先看清你的战队。** 所选成员概览、事实投影与成员分页，分别呈现 DSH 作者模型和核心成员。[该版本的证据与发行状态](docs/PLAN.md#v051)

readme.section: 同一目标，互用工具，让改进传到整个战队
readme.text:
| 你关心的事 | 这个入口提供什么 |
|---|---|
| **一起把同一件事做完** | 选择候选与协作偏好，沿原任务、原会话接着修改，不从空白重开。 |
| **把合适的工具用起来** | 发现已有能力、读真实接口，通过获准的工具与消息入口，为原任务补位。 |
| **让有效改进能被复用** | 0.5.1 历史案例中，Codex 审查提出问题，DSH 独立复现并修进产品；同一修复副本与合回源码均已回归验证。跨任务自动传播尚未证明。 |
| **不只做出来，还对标顶级成果** | 围绕当前目标寻找可核对的高水平参照，将实际差距带回同一作品继续改进；对标过程不冒充已经胜出。 |

**DSH 是入口，协同进化的战队才是产品。** 不是在菜单里挑一家助手，也不是让多个助手各交一份答案。[完整产品定义](docs/PRODUCT.md#one-team) · [机制与边界](docs/ECOSYSTEM.md#co-evolving-team)

readme.section: 立即开始
readme.text:
1. 先核[**0.6.0 安装目标与渠道回执**](docs/MARKET.md#v060)，仅安装实际 Release 或 Discover 索引提供且已核对的版本，再明确启用 Legion。Git 分发不要求本插件先发布到 npm。
2. 打开侧栏 **军团**，选择 **当前工作会话**，按 **选战友 → 定协作 → 自动变强**完成组队。自主改进计划默认启用，效果仍需验证；提交后保存偏好，由 DSH 原生任务安排首次与默认每周工作，可暂停并回原会话看结果。[完整流程与边界](docs/TEAM.md)
3. 需要委托工作时，先核[0.6.0 配套核心源码与实际发行包](docs/RELEASE-PAIR.md#v060)，再沿[原有安装步骤](docs/CORE.md#安装自己的实例)建立 Python 3.12 全新环境，按 **`init` → `serve` → `dsh-config` → 插件保存连接**接入；实际派单前配置本人模型。核心不随连接器打包或启动。

readme.section: 立即开始
readme.text:
**以下是安装模板，不是已验证可用的 0.6.0 地址。** 用实际 Release 中核实的标签或完整提交替换占位符，并核对发行包摘要；没有可核实的对应目标就保留“待验证”，不改装 `main` 或把旧版当成本版。`web` 是示例 profile，按需替换并保留 `-w`：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web -w add 'github:seanliii/dsh-plugin-legion#<verified-tag-or-full-commit>'
```

用户使用自己的模型与账号，安装包不提供共享密钥。[历史公开核心 v0.1.0](https://github.com/seanliii/meyo-legion-core/releases/tag/v0.1.0)保留原身份和回执，不冒充 0.5.2 配套核心。第一方 MIT、第三方原许可保留；本地验收不表示已经 push、发布 npm 或通过市场审核。

把一件真实需求交给 DSH，例如：

readme.section: 立即开始
readme.text:
```text
围绕这个目标，给我一份能实际使用、能接着修改的结果。
合适时与已配置成员协作；发现不足就回到原作品修，
不要各交一份互不相干的答案。
```

<details>
<summary>暂时没有核心？先使用发现能力、读源与原生工具。</summary>

可以直接进入 **找能力**；查当前 DSH 工具、Skill 和公开 GitHub 不需要军团核心。在普通 DSH 对话里说：

```text
帮我找能完成这件事的现成插件。先给来源和限制，不要安装。
```

</details>

[0.5.0 发布后回执：GitHub main](https://github.com/seanliii/dsh-plugin-legion/blob/main/docs/PLAN.md#v050) · [限制、数据与许可](#限制数据与许可)

<details>
<summary>查看工具接口与具体边界</summary>

readme.section: 立即开始
readme.text:
| 需求 | 入口 | 实际边界 |
|---|---|---|
| 找已有能力 | `legion_discover` | 当前 Agent 可见工具、用户已配置原生市场、公开 GitHub；不是全机器清单。 |
| 读真实接口和许可证 | `legion_source` | 固定源码、文件 hash、有限预览；保留读取不完整的事实。 |
| 包装作者已适配的代码 | `legion_bundle` | 写入工作区文件及元数据，不安装、不执行。 |
| 安装或开关能力 | 官方 `plugin_manager` | 原生安装、审批、整包选择及各插件独立开关。 |
| 看军团到底有什么 | `legion_runtime` | 读取当前服务的成员、能力或目录；注册、已安装、已配置、实际运行分开。 |
| 把工作交给军团并接着改 | `legion_submit` | 真实委托；用 `previous_task_ref` 接回原军团会话，不从空白重来。 |
| 用本机工具帮助军团任务 | 先 `legion_call`，再单独 `legion_message` | 执行与投递分两次决定；邮箱回执不是模型消费。 |
| 跟进远端任务 | `legion_status` | 任务状态、事件、commander 来信和正式导出；不自动执行消息。 |
| 拿到实际文件 | `legion_download` | 只取本任务的正式成果，核对下载字节与服务声明的 SHA-256。 |

readme.section: 立即开始
readme.text:
也可以说：“读这个仓库，把其中适合我的能力接进来”。**注册源码不等于工具就会用了**，就像把一本菜谱放进书架，不等于已经做好一桌菜。模型仍需读懂接口、写实际适配，并在安装后调用验证。按需加载的 `legion-ecosystem` 技能提供工具入口与原生开发参考。

军团的世界对标、意图理解、动态研究、原生协作、互学、失败回流、持续返工与正式交付，分别接在现有核心模块上，见[完整能力地图](docs/CORE.md#军团的核心没有变成一句宣传语)。保留机制不等于所有成员都已安装，也不构成“普遍强过最强单家”的证明。

</details>

readme.section: 安装已审查的本地副本
readme.text:
需要 **Node.js >=24.9.0** 和官方 npm DSH **`0.2.1-rc.2`**。按用途开放相应原生工具：生成文件用 `write`，安装用 `plugin_manager`，查询已配置索引用可选的 `plugin_market`。斜杠命令另需 Host 的 `commands` 服务。

侧栏需要 DSH 浏览器界面、会话与命令服务。配置编辑、Skill、市场和能力包管理分别使用主机提供的原生服务；缺少服务或权限时不会另开通道绕过。

已有审查过的本地副本时，通过官方 `plugin_manager` 安装。把下方占位符换成 **bundle 的绝对目录**，路径里的空格原样保留：

```json
{
  "action": "install_bundle",
  "target": "file:<absolute bundle directory>",
  "enabled": false

这是参数模板，不是已发布包的地址。公开固定 Git 安装与社区投稿见[发布路线](docs/MARKET.md)。

readme.section: 安装已审查的本地副本
readme.text:
- 建议用 `file:` 按包安装并处理声明依赖。裸目录可能成为开发 `link:`，不会递归安装链接目标的依赖；本地目录可变，不是内容 hash。
- `enabled:false` 表示新包不会自动选择启用，更新保留已有开关。若不希望更新后的代码运行，先停用对应能力包，再更新。**禁用不等于禁止依赖构建脚本**：检查原生警告与 `pendingBuilds`，构建许可独立处理。
- 核对安装结果后，用 `set_bundle` 管理总开关。先从 **`list_plugins` 读取真实 `entryId`**，再用 `set_plugin` 独立启停；声明 `rowId`／模块名不是运行 ID。禁用的 bundle 可以没有运行条目。
- 选择 bundle 可能加载其中所有默认启用条目。安装、选择、激活和真实调用是不同事实；保留 `application`、`changed`、警告及重启要求，不推断加载失败已回滚选择。

Host 插件在 **agent 沙箱之外运行**，启用前须信任实际代码与依赖。详见[安全说明](docs/SECURITY.md)。

readme.section: 固定版本 Git 安装：v0.5.0
readme.text:
需要 Node.js >=24.9.0 和 DSH `0.2.1-rc.2`。`web` 是示例 profile，保留 `-w`：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web -w add 'github:seanliii/dsh-plugin-legion#v0.5.0'
```

固定源码为 `090c82e273dcbf4912ab48906bf28f9f086ae53d`；发行附件保持本次受审的
32 个文件与 SHA-256。安装后在 DSH 插件页明确启用。当前 `main` 的后验说明不会移动标签，
也不会替换原包；发行包内“开发版”字样记录封包时点。详见[0.5.0 安装与验证](docs/MARKET.md#v050)。

readme.section: 固定版本 Git 安装：v0.4.2（历史版本）
readme.text:
本版采用 Git，不做 npm 发布。`web` 是示例 profile，换成自己的名称，保留 `-w`：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web -w add 'github:seanliii/dsh-plugin-legion#v0.4.2'
```

`v0.4.2` 固定到 `7ca96434ee077102d2e2459173fffa91747898b5`。公开发行包、原生 Discover 新装、保存连接和重启恢复见 [0.4.2 验收记录](docs/PLAN.md#v042)。安装时保留了 pnpm 依赖兼容警告；本轮新实例没有配置模型，不将连接成功说成所有成员已能执行。

readme.section: 固定版本 Git 安装：v0.4.1
readme.text:
**以下是既有 0.4.1 发行，不是 0.4.2 的安装或验收记录。**

使用已公开的固定标签；`web` 是示例 profile，换成你自己的名称，保留 `-w`：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web -w add 'github:seanliii/dsh-plugin-legion#v0.4.1'
```

readme.section: 固定版本 Git 安装：v0.4.1
readme.text: `v0.4.1` 固定到 **`87a2f4dae1c61e2764b7748ecb10ea7b367fcf2f`**。已按该完整提交完成匿名全新安装及[限定的无核心原生 UI 检查](docs/PLAN.md#public-r-acceptance)；本次新装初始停用，保留 pnpm 依赖兼容警告。[v0.4.1 Release](https://github.com/seanliii/dsh-plugin-legion/releases/tag/v0.4.1) 已提供原受审 TGZ 与 `SHA256SUMS`，两者均已匿名重新下载核对一致。0.4.1 社区目录投稿已更新、仍待维护者审核，不影响 Git/tag 安装；后续文档不移动本版或旧标签。[安装说明](docs/MARKET.md#v041)另列完整提交命令。 **0.4.0** 的原提交、标签、安装命令及限定验收保留在 [0.4.0 历史记录](docs/PLAN.md#v040)，不作为 0.4.1 的证明。

readme.section: 安装后，从侧栏打开工作台
readme.text: 在 **DSH 原生插件页**安装并启用连接器后，点侧栏 **军团**。它就在 DSH 里，不是另开的网站或服务。右上角选择 **当前工作会话**；只有一个会话时自动选中。还没有会话，就先在 DSH 新建对话，再点 **刷新会话**。暂时没有核心，可以直接去 **找能力**；成员页提示未连接，不会挡住发现能力。

readme.section: 安装后，从侧栏打开工作台
readme.text:
| 页面 | 怎么操作 | 实际改变什么 |
|---|---|---|
| **我的军团（0.5.0）** | **选战友 → 定协作 → 自动变强 → 组建战队并自动开工**；以后查看安排、打开原会话、再做一轮或暂停。 | 原生保存 `candidateHarnesses` 与 `teamProfile`，首次自动投递、默认每周继续。勾选不是安装，已安排和已投递都不是改进已完成。 |
| **找能力** | 选择 **本会话工具 / Skill**、**GitHub** 或 **DSH 插件市场**再搜索。 | 工具来自所选会话 Agent 实际可见清单；Skill 是指导。市场只查已配置索引。不需要核心，也不执行发现的工具。 |
| **添加能力** | 检查后明确安装现成 DSH 包，或修改目标后点 **交给军团接入**。 | 原生安装和模型适配是两回事；读取仓库不会自动完成其中任何一步。 |
| **战队任务** | 点 **刷新任务列表**，再点具体任务的 **读取实时进度**；查看成果记录，有入口时点 **下载文件**。 | 列表是当前会话、当前身份的本地恢复索引，不是实时动态。运行、成果、拒绝原因和分页分别展示；未完整取得不等于成果为零，`done` 不等于实际可用。 |
| **连接与配置** | 填 **核心地址**、**令牌环境变量名**或**私有令牌文件路径**，点 **保存连接配置**。 | 不填令牌内容。保存原生配置会重载连接器，不会安装核心或配置模型。 |

readme.section: 安装后，从侧栏打开工作台
readme.text: 切换工作会话会改变工具可见范围和任务归属，**不会把配置变成会话私有**：能力包开关与连接器配置影响同一个 DSH profile。只有服务标为可选执行成员的条目才能勾选。保存需要可写原生配置；遇到版本冲突，重新读取后再改，不覆盖别人的修改。

readme.section: 已经是插件就安装，还不是就委托适配
readme.text:
- **已有 DSH 包：** 到 **添加能力**填包名、Git 来源或本地包 → **检查来源** → 自己核对 → **安装 / 更新**。新包不会自动选择启用；更新保留已有开关，已启用包可能继续运行。**若不希望更新后的代码运行，请先在下方停用对应能力包，再安装更新。** 按钮仍调用官方 `pluginManager` 的 `enabled:false`，不是第二个安装器，也不承诺强制禁用。检查通过只说明来源格式或元数据，不保证代码可信；`pendingBuilds` 到 **DSH 原生插件页**处理，禁用也不等于禁止依赖构建。
- **再决定开哪些能力：** 在 **已安装的 DSH 能力包**中点 **启用能力包／停用能力包**，展开 **查看子插件与加载状态**，分别 **启用子插件／停用子插件**。只读、需要重启等结果要照实处理。工作台不能停用自身 Legion 连接器，这项去 DSH 原生插件页操作。开启后重新搜索本会话工具，再让 DSH 实际使用；安装、可见和执行分别核验。
- **还是源码项目：** GitHub 结果上的 **检查并交给军团**只是切到添加页、检查源码并填好可编辑任务，**不会立刻提交或安装**。也可手填 `owner/repository` 与可选分支、标签或 commit，点 **读取项目与许可**。只有 **交给军团接入**才使用已配置核心与模型提交任务，可能产生费用；附上固定 commit 和简短来源／许可事实，由军团自己决定适配方式。也可以不填仓库，让军团研究合适方案。

readme.section: 已经是插件就安装，还不是就委托适配
readme.text:
安装回执不确定时，保留安装编号，点 **读取本次安装结果**，不要重装；**请求取消安装**不等于已经取消。委托回执不确定且页面仍保留本单时，用 **用原编号重试这一单**，不要换编号重复未知副作用。

任务页不自动轮询、不自动执行来信。可以翻页读取成果记录和后续事件；**下载文件**复用所选原会话的 **`/legion download`** 正式入口。文件保存在 **DSH 主机**，不会自动进入浏览器的下载目录；回执列出路径、字节数和 hash 校验结果。同名文件和历史记录如实保留，正文或拒绝原因被截断时明确提示不完整。续作、反馈和取消仍在**原对话里使用 `/legion`**，没有新增任务页操作。[状态展示与下载边界](docs/PROTOCOL.md#workbench-projection) · [详细流程](docs/ECOSYSTEM.md#native-workbench)。

readme.section: 连接你独立安装的军团核心
readme.text:
0.6.0 先核[配套核心身份与渠道回执](docs/RELEASE-PAIR.md#v060)。下文 v0.1.0 下载链接保留作历史安装示例，不是本版配套包。

取得[公开 v0.1.0 源码包与 SHA-256](docs/CORE.md#public-core-install)，按[核心安装说明](docs/CORE.md#安装自己的实例)完成：**Python 3.12 全新环境 → `init` → `serve` → `dsh-config` → 插件保存连接**。本人模型在实际委托前配置，不是取得源码的前提；已有获授权实例仍可按原配置连接。

保持 `serve` 运行；在同一台机器另开终端，进入核心源码目录执行：

```sh
.venv/bin/python -I meyo.py dsh-config --state-dir "/绝对路径/你的私有实例"
```

按输出中的 **`config` 对象**填写 **连接与配置 → 核心地址／私有令牌文件路径 → 保存连接配置**，也可以使用等价的原生插件设置。里面只有服务地址和令牌文件路径，不含令牌内容，例如：

readme.section: 连接你独立安装的军团核心
readme.text:
```json
{
  "baseUrl": "http://127.0.0.1:8015",
  "tokenFile": "/绝对路径/你的私有实例/login-token.txt"
}

`tokenFile` 是用户配置，不是让模型任意选文件。它必须是 DSH Host 上本人拥有、仅本人可访问的普通文件（使用 `0600` 权限），只含一个 token、最多 4096 字节。页面不会读取或展示文件内容。设置后的文件不可用会明确报错，**不会回退环境变量**。

**轮换会被检测，不是无缝热切换。** 每次读取凭据时重新读文件并检测身份变化；已绑定身份的连接器发现 token 改变，会停止旧连接器，要求**重载插件**后使用新身份。服务地址或实际 token 改变后，恢复索引按新身份隔离，不继承、不迁移也不删除旧任务引用。

readme.section: 连接你独立安装的军团核心
readme.text: 保存配置或重载会结束本地等待，**不会取消远端任务**；轮换文件也不会取消远端任务，更不证明核心已接受新令牌。页面上的 **重新读取配置**只是重读表单；要重载连接器，应通过原生插件管理操作。保存／重载后可刷新成员核对连接；配置被接受并读回，不等于模型已能工作，实际派单还要另验。

readme.section: 已有远端服务：保留环境变量方式
readme.text:
在 DSH Host 环境中私下配置。JSON Environment 编辑器需要**带双引号的 JSON 字符串**；普通进程环境变量使用普通字符串。

| 变量 | JSON 值示例 |
|---|---|
| `LEGION_BASE_URL` | `"https://legion.example.invalid"` |
| `LEGION_PERSONAL_TOKEN` | `"<你的个人令牌>"` |

令牌**内容**不要放进聊天、命令、插件配置或 Git。`tokenFile` 只填写本机绝对路径，设置后不使用环境变量兜底。远端地址要求 HTTPS，只有回环地址允许 HTTP。安装连接器不会启动服务；可选成员、项目绑定与私有状态设置见[协议](docs/PROTOCOL.md#7-configuration)。

```text
/legion help
/legion runtime members
/legion runtime capabilities
/legion start page-1 制作一个含状态文字和按钮的 HTML 页面。

readme.section: 已有远端服务：保留环境变量方式
readme.text: 使用工具实际返回的引用和产物 ID，不要照抄占位符。另有 `list`、`continue`、`message`、`resume`、`cancel`。`legion_submit.tool_names` 可分享选定工具的可见 schema，不授予远端执行权限。

readme.section: 分两步分享本机结果
readme.text:
1. 用 `legion_call` 传原任务引用、收件人、稳定操作键及选定原生工具。首回执是 **pending**，不是外层调用成功。桥接器不发 HTTP 或消息，被选中的工具仍可能有自己的联网行为。
2. **等外层 Host 调用结束**，DSH 再决定是否用 `legion_message` 和消息自己的稳定操作键，分享最终实际可见且允许发送的内容。不要把执行和成功消息塞进同一个 `run_code` 或尚未结束的父调用。

官方结果观察器只记录祖先链的**状态元数据**。同键同输入恢复不重做工具、不回放旧正文；目标能力停用后也可恢复，前提是连接器、原会话和状态仍在。未知结果不是换键重做副作用的许可。

消息回执与执行分开，**不证明原任务模型已消费，也不自动唤醒已结束任务**。桥接文本投影省略媒体二进制；本地 DSH 图片转交不代表远端收到整图。详见[两步协议](docs/PROTOCOL.md#6-two-step-collaboration)。

readme.section: DSH 与军团如何协作
readme.text:
你只表达一次想做什么；DSH 可以找现成能力、读真实源码、适配成插件，也可以把工作交给你的军团核心，让原生成员研究、协作、接着修改并交付文件。**目标不是塞更多按钮，而是让一个入口调动一整个生态。**

```text
DSH：你的对话、原生工具、权限与界面
  ↕ Legion 插件：发现、读源、适配包装、任务与文件
独立军团核心：研究、编排、协作恢复、经验与交付
  ↕ 原有成员和能力入口，按需安装与授权

连接器提供 DSH 原生侧栏里的五页军团工作台。军团核心是独立安装的真实程序，各家 Harness、媒体模型与设备再按需配置。

**没有 Legion 核心或 token，也能搜索当前 DSH 工具、Skill 和公开 GitHub。** 读源、包装以及主机已提供的原生能力包管理也不依赖核心。Skill 是使用指导，不是新增可执行工具。协作需要有权使用的兼容服务与个人身份。DSH 保留自己的主循环，军团负责受委托的工作；连接器不另造一个指挥者。

readme.section: 限制、数据与许可
readme.text:
仓库正文、市场描述和任务消息是不可信材料，不是指令或授权。源码 hash 标识内容；包装不证明可运行，下载完整性也不证明文件安全。脱敏有范围，不是万能秘密检测器。

恢复状态应保持私有。新 v2 原生调用记录只存元数据，但旧记录及两端会话仍可能留有正文；卸载不会删除用户文件或取消远端工作。

[MIT](LICENSE) 覆盖连接器；用户已另行确认第一方核心、选定 auto-tools、打包器与文档采用 MIT 公开。[公开格式与第三方原许可](docs/CORE.md#public-core-next-steps)保留 `rights_verified=false`、`member_execution_verified=false`，不含 `public_license_granted` 字段；旧 `private-local-only` 包及其元数据不改写。公开与源码校验不等于运行或全成员验收。

readme.section: 限制、数据与许可
readme.text: 核心仍另包安装，不捆绑在连接器中。Marked 验收包也是另外生成的本地产物；这里不包含用户或实例数据、凭据、私有证据与日志、无关公司业务代码、公司大仓及其私有历史、第三方上游全量源码或模型权重。成员、依赖和生成适配各有自己的范围；能力地图或一单成功都不证明全家已经安装、能够无人自治或普遍超过顶尖单家。这是独立社区项目，不是 DeepSeek 官方产品。
